summary.text: Neil Gillespie, a candidate with no party affiliation who describes himself as the founder and director of Justice Network, an advocacy and news organization, lost the November 3, 2026 special election for the U.S. Senate seat in Florida to Ashley Moody.
He said he ran because of what he called a lack of due process in state and federal courts, and on separation of powers and health care reform.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey response, Neil Gillespie moved to Florida from Pennsylvania in 1993, where he had been a licensed motor vehicle dealer.
He earned an associate degree from the Wharton School's evening division at the University of Pennsylvania in 1988 and a bachelor's degree from The Evergreen State College in 1995.
Gillespie describes himself as founder and director of Justice Network, an organization engaged in advocacy, education and news gathering to help people fight injustice.
He received 1.1% of the vote to Ashley Moody's 50.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
